$comment: Contract of the Media blocks (escala-governance step 2): MediaPlayer, MediaPlayerTrack and NowPlaying on the Figma page ❖ MediaPlayer & NowPlaying (PRO). Each is an arrangement of escala-ui components in role tokens. Accepted exceptions: the MediaPlayer card's 40 corner (the file draws it raw, no role between Radius/overlay 24 and full); the covers are stand-ins (the file's photos are stock content, not tokens); a clock plays the 24-second sample (no audio file).

blocks.name: MediaPlayer
anatomy: Card 640: Surface/layer-1, Border/default, padding Spacing/inset-surface, gap Spacing/gap-group
info: title (Type/heading-xs) + subtitle (Type/body-sm, Content/secondary) and the transport
transport: IconButton ghost (Previous) · IconButton secondary solid lg round (Play / Pause) · IconButton ghost (Next)
playlist-header: Playlist (Type/label) + volume (IconButton ghost sm + Slider xs 160)
a11y: Every control has an accessible name; Play/Pause and Mute/Unmute change their name
Both sliders announce their value ("0:12 of 0:24", "70%")

motion.mechanism: rail appears on the current row

blocks.name: MediaPlayerTrack
anatomy: Row Size/control-lg, Radius/action, padding Spacing/inset-control, gap Spacing/gap-control
Focused: 2px ring on Border/ring/default, 1px outside the row
a11y: A button; the current row carries aria-current

blocks.name: NowPlaying
anatomy: Surface/layer-2, Border/default, Radius/overlay, Shadow/lg, padding Spacing/inset-control
IconButton secondary solid lg round (Play / Pause) + IconButton ghost (Next)
